CREATE TABLE Nutrition (
  alcohol,
  calories,
  carbo,
  cholestrl,
  fiber,
  iron,
  pcnt_cal_carb,
  pcnt_cal_fat,
  pcnt_cal_prot,
  protein,
  recipe_id,
  sat_fat,
  sodium,
  total_fat,
  vitamin_a,
  vitamin_c
);

CREATE TABLE Quantity (
  ingredient_id,
  max_qty,
  min_qty,
  optional,
  preparation,
  quantity_id,
  recipe_id,
  unit
);

CREATE TABLE Recipe (
  cook_min,
  directions,
  intro,
  prep_min,
  recipe_id,
  servings,
  source,
  stnd_min,
  subtitle,
  title,
  yield_unit
